## Summary

I implemented the audit-line requirement in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` — the single `POST /api/owners` create handler.

**Changes to `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:**

1. Added an SLF4J logger named exactly `AUDIT`:
   ```java
   private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT");
   ```

2. Emitted the audit line immediately after the owner is successfully persisted (so the generated `id` is populated), carrying the owner id, customerCode, and registrationDate:
   ```java
   this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);
   AUDIT.info("owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={}",
       owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate());
   ```

The log is placed after `saveOwner` and after all validation/quota checks, so it only fires on a successful create — matching the spec ("on successful create"). The test `AcceptanceTest.coreLogsAuditOnCreate` captures the `AUDIT` logger and asserts the line contains all three values; the observed output was `AUDIT - owner created id=11 customerCode=TOW-SUR-0001 registrationDate=2026-08-11`, and the suite reports `BUILD SUCCESS` with `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
